400.title: 400 - Bad request
400.desc: User did not provide required arguments. Please retry it.

401.title: 401 - Unauthorized
401.desc: User did not provide any authorization information. Please log in.

403.title: 403 - Forbidden
403.desc: User does not have access to this page. Navigate to other page or log out.

404.title: 404 - Not found
404.desc: Required path or request on API was not found.

500.title: 500 - Internal server error
500.desc: Server encountered error while processing request. Please try it again later.

503.title: 503 - Service unavailable
503.desc: Server can not process the request or API is not available. Please try it again later.
